test_image_to_image_simple: test the image-to-image API endpoint by sending a base64 encoded JPEG image with a prompt parameter
test_image_to_image_malformed_input: test the image-to-image API endpoint by sending malformed binary data and verifying a 400 error response
test_image_to_image_parameterized_models: test the image-to-image API against all parameterized models listed in TESTABLE_MODELS for the image-to-image task
review_ImageToImageTestCase: review the ImageToImageTestCase class that sets up and tears down MODEL_ID and TASK environment variables for each test
test_image_to_image_pipeline_cache: test the image-to-image pipeline by clearing the get_pipeline cache before running parameterized model tests
